name: jiggly-button
title: Jiggly Button
description: A button that squashes and wobbles back into shape, like jelly, when you hover or press it.
behaviour: On hover, press, or both, the button squashes wider and shorter in a tenth of a second, then springs back to its natural shape over duration with an elastic ease, so it wobbles a few times before settling. intensity sets how far it squashes. A new wobble overwrites one already running rather than adding to it, so pressing repeatedly never leaves the button stretched. Pressing with Enter or Space counts as a press. Scaling happens around the centre and doesn't move the hit area. It is a real button: your own onClick, onPointerEnter, onPointerDown and every other prop still work. Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce it never moves.
